dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: So bored... Need someone to play with...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Mom and dad don't have time to come home and play with me, so I have to play here all by myself. But it's so boring playing with only one person...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Also, I can't stray too far from home, otherwise mom and dad wouldn't be able to find me when they got back, and then they'd start worrying.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Do you wanna play with me? We can play hide-and-seek, it's really easy, anyone can play it.
